conversion.crosscheck_limit: TIMER3 and coarse OS milliseconds are read separately; coarse milliseconds advance in 10 ms units. This supports, but does not physically calibrate, nominal conversion.

field_semantics.STG: Seven stage durations, avg/max ticks over each completed 512-block window. A block is 128 samples in this path. win increases on publication; stage maxima need not belong to the same block.
field_semantics.STG_lat: Worker-start TIMER3 minus timestamp when the input callback completed a 128-sample input block; non-positive signed result is clamped to zero. Excludes collection of that block and codec conversion.
field_semantics.STG_blk: Worker-start to end of processing/output-ring publication. Excludes output-ring waiting, DAC/filter delay and input-block acquisition.
field_semantics.STG_eng: Original engine-stage interval including the dedicated A2 call. Not the complete chain or ADC-to-DAC latency.
field_semantics.STG_isr: Separate average/max of the handler at 0x01C03278 over 1024 invocations; not the same 512-block window as the other fields.
field_semantics.T: nproc increments after a completed A2 process call, which handles two 64-sample jobs. last/max/avg are TIMER3 durations of this call; avg is cumulative, max is cleared by STAT.
field_semantics.W: Original espera_c0 diagnostic is retained as a wait observation, not reinterpreted as analog latency or complete block time.
field_semantics.RS: First at most 16 lat/eng/blk triples after nonzero audio-mode start; integer microseconds using the nominal clock formula. Counter stops at16 and STAT does not rearm it. Not a rolling sample series.
field_semantics.NIVEL: Peaks and clipping/limiter counters. LVL ci/co mean input/output clips, not sample counts; zeros are valid. STAT clears peak accumulators and T.max, not configuration or NOR.

measurement_plan.status: planned only; no FX mutation performed by this audit
measurement_plan.scope: Use the chosen preset with every present effect enabled, or a gradually admitted stress chain when no preset is specified. Do not label either as all 37 types simultaneously.
measurement_plan.prerequisite: Root verifies actual first-preset PSAVE/SNAPSAVE/PLOAD roundtrip before stress; preserve the saved baseline and use PLOAD 0 to restore when that slot has been physically established.
preserve: FXS blocks, bank/order, enabled flags, parameters, mix/routing and actual oversampling
FXT ranges and MEM resource state
measurement_plan.freshness: Read STAT immediately after a settled state; require at least two later STG window increments before accepting a measurement, then collect 3-5 distinct complete STG windows while FXS/model/gain/clock remain unchanged.
report: Raw ticks and nominal time conversion
STG avg/max and window numbers; no percentile from averages
Overrun, underrun, full, error, timeout, skipped/cancelled deltas
measurement_plan.mutations: Separate exact experimental FXA/FXP/FXE trial only; no general app family grant from this plan. No PSAVE/GSAVE or deletion of existing slots during latency stress.
avoid: Do not use stale RS as new latency data
Do not sum stage maxima as one observed block
Do not subtract unrelated maxima to infer effect cost
Do not force rejected CPU/memory allocations
Do not reset audio solely to rearm RS

physical_measurement.status: not performed; no confirmed physical routing or measurement interface
physical_measurement.method: With routing confirmed, record a reference signal and the processed analog output simultaneously, and compare their time positions; account for reference-path skew and the acquisition interface. USB command-response time is not audio latency.
physical_measurement.effect_limit: Delay/reverb predelay, pitch windows and modulation intentionally shift/spread signal energy; report earliest/dry-path transport and effect delay separately. A strongest correlation peak alone may select an intended echo.
physical_measurement.inventory_limit: Generic Windows USB Audio names do not identify MINI or a usable measurement interface; do not infer physical routing from them.
